name: Leto utrativshego nadezhdu
source: The story revolves around the protagonist, Sergey, who can hardly be called an average isekai character. His main struggle in life is constant self-reflection, hidden behind a wall of irony. The core message is something each reader will discover for themselves. The plot promises to be intricate, but it will give you a chance to watch the protagonist grow throughout his journey, during which he uncovers intriguing details about the reasons behind his arrival at the camp.
translation: 故事围绕主角谢尔盖展开，他很难被称为一般的异世界角色。他一生的主要斗争是不断的自我反省，隐藏在讽刺之墙后面。核心信息是每个读者都会自己发现的。剧情肯定会很复杂，但它会让你有机会看到主角在整个旅程中成长，在此期间他会发现有关他到达营地背后原因的有趣细节。
